crownPassive.name: Hard frost
crownPassive.text: In every round that you hold the Fate token, all enemy front-rank cards are frozen and skip their automatic actions.

bond.name: Eventyr kin
bond.text: +1 Guard for each other Eventyr hero you field.

actions.name: Shard of the mirror
